title: Clover and the Cloud Sheep
description: A little lamb learns to embrace her unique curly wool after trying to straighten it out all morning.
character_reference: a small white lamb with impossibly bouncy tight corkscrew curls and a cheerful pink nose

scenes.narration: Clover gazed at her reflection in the pond, sighing as her bouncy wool puffed out in every direction.
scenes.visual: close up of a calm woodland pond reflecting soft morning sky while a fluffy animal stares down at the water

scenes.narration: All the other sheep had sleek, neat coats, while hers looked like a fluffy white powder puff that refused to settle.
scenes.visual: meadow scene showing distant sheep grazing peacefully on green hills under a bright blue morning sky

scenes.narration: She spent the whole morning trying to flatten her curls with damp clover leaves and gentle pats.
scenes.visual: close up of small hooves trying to smooth down an unruly patch of fluffy white wool in a patch of green clover

scenes.narration: An old butterfly fluttered down and rested right on top of her highest, springiest curl.
scenes.visual: macro shot of a yellow butterfly perched delicately on a tuft of textured white wool against a soft green bokeh background

scenes.narration: Your wool is like a cozy cloud, the butterfly whispered gently, soft enough to catch falling daydreams.
scenes.visual: side profile of the fluffy protagonist smiling gently while looking upward at a resting insect

scenes.narration: Clover shook her head playfully, and her curls bounced right back into their happy, cheerful shape.
scenes.visual: motion blur shot of white wool bouncing joyfully in the sunlight with grass blades rustling nearby

scenes.narration: She realized her unique curls made her special, keeping her warm and ready for any cozy meadow game.
scenes.visual: wide shot of the sunny meadow with wildflowers blooming around the happy animal resting in the grass

scenes.narration: Our differences are what make us wonderful, just like every cloud in the sky has its own lovely shape.
scenes.visual: gorgeous sunset sky filled with fluffy golden and pink cumulus clouds drifting lazily overhead

scenes.narration: If you love sweet animal stories as much as we do, follow along for more bedtime tales tomorrow.
scenes.visual: cozy twilight meadow scene with fireflies beginning to glow softly in the tall summer grass
